Unique proposition
Explain the Data · Decision Layer

This is not a static visualization. It is an interactive food-delivery operations control tower: filters change the KPIs, charts, city map, restaurant ranking and management signals together.

What the dashboard answers

1 · What is happening? Orders, revenue, average order value, delivery time and rating show the current operating state.

2 · Where is it happening? The India map links city-level revenue to geography so the evaluator can immediately see concentration and compare markets.

3 · Why does it matter? Category, restaurant and order-status views expose demand drivers and service friction.

4 · What happens next? The ARIMA panel extends historical demand into a 30-day forecast for planning capacity and inventory.

Traceability

Click Explore CSV to move from the dashboard back to the underlying order-level records. That makes every headline metric auditable instead of looking like a presentation mock-up.

Unique proposition: “The dashboard doesn't just visualize food-delivery data; it creates a traceable decision layer connecting order-level data → business KPIs → operational insights → demand forecasting.”
